Answered. Browse our quick answers for decision making. Good to know before order. As, your convenience matter to us.

Yes! You can conveniently order your favorite breads, croissants, pastries, and sandwiches through our online store. Orders can be collected from any of our bakery locations in Zurich (Bleicherweg and Vulkanplatz), Erlenbach, and Thalwil. For the next-day pick up or delivery, please ensure your order is placed in our online store before 5 am.
We certainly do. Juliette delivers fresh baked goods directly to your home in the Zurich area. For next-day delivery, please ensure your order is placed in our online store before 5 am.

Our products are made with passion and precision using traditional French baking techniques. A key secret to our quality is the flour selected by Juliette, which is supplied directly by the renowned Foricher mills in France.

Yes, Juliette provide a tailormade offer for breakfasts, business lunches, or stylish aperitifs. We provide a variety of platters, finger food, and seasonal specialties tailored for meetings and team events. Contact us via the online form Event & catering
